title: About the Library - Högskolebiblioteket
text:
About the Library - Högskolebiblioteket
Skip to main content
The ÅUAS Library is for those studying or working at the Åland University of Applied Sciences. You can borrow course literature, search for material in online databases or make an appointment with a librarian for help with information retrieval.
The ÅUAS library is in the same building as Mariehamn City Library. The university library’s material is integrated into the Mariehamn City Library collections with the exception of the university’s coursebooks which can be found in their own section — the coursebook library.
The coursebook library is situated farthest in on the ground floor. As well as course literature there are also three study desks with computers reserved for the university’s students.
At the Mariehamn City Library
In addition to the university’s study desks the library provides small study rooms suitable for group work. The library also has very generous opening hours and a large selection of fiction and non-fiction literature, magazines, films and more.
Borrowing books and journals
The lending of all materials is done at Mariehamn City Library. The Åland University of Applied Sciences’ books and journals are
searchable in the library catalogue,  bibliotek.ax
,
where you can find material from all libraries on Åland.
Library and information service
The university library provides expert guidance in information retrieval for all students at the Åland University of Applied Sciences. Teachers, researchers and other staff at the university also have access to the university library services.
A large part of the library’s material is available in electronic form via the ÅUAS library website.
